metadata.title: Perelman's entropy and Gromov-Hausdorff versus dynamical stability of round spheres
metadata.abstract: We study the Gromov-Hausdorff stability of round spheres under perturbations of Perelman's nu-entropy. We show that in dimension two almost maximal entropy, together with an area normalisation, implies Gromov-Hausdorff closeness to the round two-sphere. In contrast, in dimensions at least three, we construct smooth metrics on the sphere whose entropies converge to that of the round sphere, but which remain a definite Gromov-Hausdorff distance away from it. These metrics can be chosen conformal and uniformly bi-Lipschitz equivalent to the round metric, with the same volume as the round sphere. Finally, in dimension three, we contrast this Gromov-Hausdorff instability with a dynamical stability result: metrics with nu-entropy above that of the round shrinking cylinder converge exponentially fast to round metrics under the volume-normalised Ricci flow.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究 Perelman ν 熵接近圆球值是否强迫 Gromov–Hausdorff 接近圆球。
techniques: 共形度量构造与体积归一化 Ricci 流
analysis.breakthrough: 在余维二全测地球面的收缩管邻域内作固定幅度共形缩短，用双对数截断和临界 Hardy 界控制熵损失，保留固定距离畸变。二维面积4π且 ν 趋于圆球值时则得到球面拓扑及 GH 收敛。三维 ν 超过圆柱值可保证归一化流指数收敛。
analysis.limitations: GH 比较需固定体积尺度。反例是 n≥3 的光滑等体积、统一双 Lipschitz 共形度量。动力学定理只在三维给出相应熵阈值结论。补读主定理及路线，未独立核验整篇证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露公开 LLM 用于校对、文献检索和简化部分估计，特别是定理1.2的证明。作者审查并修订所采纳建议，主思路及数学路线归于作者。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.06678v1 · PDF 第5页 AI disclosure statement

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露公开 LLM 用于校对、文献检索和简化部分估计，特别是定理1.2的证明。作者审查并修订所采纳建议，主思路及数学路线归于作者。

analysis.priorityReason: 区分熵所控制的距离几何与流长期行为。
